svg.title: Greedy walk with a candidate list of 1 and of 4
svg.desc: 46 points, each linked to its 3 nearest (both ways). The walk starts at the point farthest from the query. With ef_search 1 it moves to a closer neighbour while one exists and stops after 6 steps at the 9th nearest point. With ef_search 4 it keeps the 4 closest points seen so far, expands 11 of them, checks 21 of 46 points and finds the true nearest.
svg.text: A greedy walk through a neighbour graph
ef_search = size of the candidate list
